semantics.clock: State changes on positive clk edges as explicitly specified.
semantics.reset: Positive edge asynchronous areset resets to walking left; asserted reset holds left at clock edges.
semantics.outputs: Moore outputs: walking left=(1,0,0), walking right=(0,1,0), falling=(0,0,1).
semantics.walking: At a clock edge, absent ground has priority over bumps. With ground, left-facing switches only on bump_left and right-facing switches only on bump_right; both bumps switch direction.
semantics.falling: Retain pre-fall direction. Ignore both bumps on entry, during fall, and landing. Resume retained direction on the edge sampling ground=1.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state specified; verification asserts asynchronous reset before expecting defined outputs.

numeric.state_space: Four states: walk left/right and fall retaining left/right.

verification.oracle: Independent direction and falling history model derived from original problem.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs at falling edges; compare Moore outputs before and after rising edges, after NBA settling. Assert reset between clock edges.
verification.coverage: All bump combinations in both directions, fall entry priority, persistent fall, landing priority, reset while walking and falling, exhaustive short input sequences.
verification.success: Bounded timeout, fatal on mismatch, PASS only after every check.

specification_ambiguities: Power-up behavior before any reset is unspecified; no defined output is assumed before reset.
